title: Salesforce Data Analysis Manager, APAC
job_description:
ROLE OBEJECTIVE:

Responsible for leveraging internal and external data to generate insights that guide commercial decisions, monitor pipeline health, and evaluate program effectiveness. Provide regular reporting and dashboards that support both regional and market sales teams.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Salesforce Data Analysis 

Analyze opportunity and pipeline data to identify patterns by market, segment, and customer type. 

Track key metrics such as stage conversions, win/loss ratios, and sales cycle durations. 

Generate insights to inform sales strategy, pipeline management, and go-to-market decisions.  

Dashboard Development & Reporting 

Build and maintain Salesforce or Tableau dashboards for commercial visibility and performance tracking. 

Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting packs with narrative summaries of key findings.

Ensure reports are visually clear, accurate, and accessible for different management levels 

Forecasting & Pipeline Modeling 

Support the sales forecasting process by modeling expected revenue from open opportunities. 

Develop trend-based projections and scenario analyses to inform business planning. 

Validate forecast assumptions and flag potential risks or bottlenecks.  

Campaign & Program  Impact Analysis 

Measure the effectiveness of regional B2B campaigns and customer engagement programs.

Correlate engagement data (e.g., event attendance, specifications) with pipeline creation or conversion outcomes. 

Provide post-program analytics and recommendations for future initiatives.  

Market & External Data Integration 

Integrate external market intelligence (e.g., construction starts, project pipelines) with Salesforce data. 

Identify emerging market opportunities or segments with high growth potential.    

Produce insight summaries for sales and marketing planning sessions.  

Collaboration & Support for International Key Account and Local Key Account Teams 

Partner with International Key Account (IKA) and local sales teams to provide analytics support and reports. 

Respond to ad-hoc data requests and ensure data consistency across markets. 

Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Lead to align reporting structures with system standards.  

Data Quality Monitoring 

Monitor completeness and accuracy of Salesforce data; flag issues to market administrators. 

Support ongoing data cleansing and standardization efforts. 

Recommend process improvements to improve analytics reliability.




KEY RELATIONSHIP: 

This role works closely with the following functions:  

International Key Account and Local Key Account B2B Sales and Specs Teams 

Regional Channel Marketing 

Market Salesforce Administrators 

Commercial Leadership         




JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

General Qualifications: 

Bachelorʼs Degree in Business, Data Science, Statistics, or Finance 

4–6 yrs (for Asst. Manager) or 6-9  years (for Manager)  in data analytics, business intelligence, or commercial strategy.  

Experience: 

Strong experience with Salesforce reporting 

Proficient in Tableau, and Google apps (Sheets,Slides, Looker Studio) 

Experience with market intelligence or industry data sources preferred 

Strong analytical thinking and storytelling with data

Managing analysis of soil moisture, rainfall, evapotranspiration, and Vapour Pressure Deficit/VPD to support precision water management.

Developing plantation water balance analysis to help minimize crop stress and maintain productivity.

Supporting the implementation and use of wireless soil sensors and IoT devices for real-time field condition monitoring.

Job Description for Factory IT Business Analyst (BA)




II. Core Job Responsibilities




1. Business Research and Pain Point Identification: Go deep into the factory's production workshops and warehouse frontlines, fully familiarize yourself with the entire warehouse process of "receiving, storing, issuing, counting, and managing" (including purchase warehousing, production material picking, production material returning, sales outbound, inventory counting, etc.) and the entire production process (production order maintenance, bill of materials management, production reporting, production warehousing, etc.). Sort out the existing business processes, job responsibilities and collaboration models, accurately identify business pain points, bottlenecks and optimization spaces, and form a business research and analysis report.




2. Requirements Analysis and Document Conversion: Combine the results of business research, collaborate efficiently with business departments such as production, warehousing and purchasing, collect, sort out and analyze business requirements. Convert complex business scenarios and operation processes into clear, standardized and implementable IT requirement documents, including but not limited to Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), flow charts, use case diagrams, etc. Ensure that the requirement description is accurate, the logic is clear, it is consistent with the actual business scenario of the factory, and bridge the cognitive gap between the IT development team and the business departments.




3. Project Implementation and Requirement Control: Participate in the entire process of requirement review, solution design, test verification and launch promotion of factory IT systems (such as MES, WMS, ERP production/warehousing modules, etc.), follow up the progress of requirement implementation throughout the process, coordinate and solve the connection problems between business and IT during the project implementation, ensure that the system functions meet the business requirements, and improve business operation efficiency.




4. Process Optimization and System Iteration: Continuously track the operation effect of production and warehousing business processes and IT systems, put forward requirement optimization suggestions based on business changes (such as capacity improvement, process adjustment) and system usage feedback, and promote the iterative upgrading of IT systems; assist business departments in sorting out standardized business processes, realize "process reengineering" based on "online processes", and help improve business efficiency.




III. Job Qualifications




(I) Hard Requirements




1. Education and Major: Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer-related fields (Computer Science and Technology, Information Management and Information System, etc.), Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management and other related majors are preferred.




2. Work Experience: More than 3 years of relevant work experience as a factory IT Business Analyst (BA), must have business analysis experience related to factory warehouse management and production processes, be familiar with the entire process of factory production execution and warehouse management, and be able to independently complete business research, requirement analysis and requirement document writing.




3. Core Competencies: Possess strong requirement conversion ability, able to convert complex factory business scenarios (such as warehouse batch management, production material kitting analysis, inventory traceability, etc.) into standardized and implementable IT requirement documents; have clear logical thinking and problem analysis ability, able to quickly locate business pain points and put forward reasonable optimization solutions.




4. Successful Cases: At least 1 successful factory IT project case must be provided (which must include warehouse or production-related scenarios), clearly explaining the business analysis responsibilities undertaken in the project, the requirement conversion process and the project implementation results (such as quantifiable indicators such as process optimization efficiency, inventory accuracy improvement, energy consumption reduction, etc.), and the case must be true and traceable.

Contracting Empire is a marketing agency that works exclusively with high-ticket contractors in the US. We build websites, SEO, local SEO, and paid media systems that move the needle for our clients. We're not a checkbox agency, and we're not looking for checkbox people.

You understand, write, and speak English at a native level. This is non-negotiable, and we'll test it in the first minutes of your interview.

You treat SEO as a living system, not a checklist. You're obsessed with staying ahead of what's changing.

You don't need your hand held. You know what needs to happen, you identify your own tasks, and you move.

You get uncomfortable when results plateau, and you don't wait to be told to fix it.

You make decisions based on data, not gut feeling.

You actively experiment with SEO, AI, automations, and new workflows because building efficient systems is something you actually enjoy.

AI is part of your daily workflow, and you take full advantage of it.

You hold yourself to a high standard in everything you do, not just the parts people are watching.

You're genuinely invested in the success of your clients and your colleagues, not just your own output.

You know how to keep the team updated and ask the right questions without being policed.

You're comfortable talking to clients, shooting video reports, and keeping them in the loop because their results matter to you.

You see your work as more than just a paycheck.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end. That means full visibility into what's working, what's not, and what needs to happen next — without being reminded.

Running Ahrefs audits, technical cleanups, and site maintenance (zombie pages, crawl issues, the works) without being asked twice

Monitoring GTmetrix, Search Console, and Analytics because you want to know, not because someone told you to check

Citation work, local SEO management via BrightLocal, and the repetitive-but-critical tasks that keep accounts healthy

Identifying constraints, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities across your accounts and acting on them

Keeping clients informed through video reports and direct communication — because you're invested in their success

What Makes You Stand Out

We don't want someone who checks tasks off a list and calls it a day. We want someone who digs deeper because this is genuinely something they care about.

You own outcomes, not tasks. You understand SEO and local SEO as a whole system, and you take full responsibility for what happens on your accounts. Agency experience is a must.

You see what others miss. You analyze data to find constraints and improvements and you act on them without being asked.

You think in solutions. Complex problems don't slow you down. You test hypotheses, adjust based on evidence, and keep moving.

You set your own bar. We don't want to tell you how to do your job. You should be able to tell us.

Provide level‑1 functional support and escalate to in‑house dev/vendor where needed.

title: Database Architect (Senior Level)
job_description:
As a Senior Database Architect at PT JAYA AGUNG TEKNOLOGI, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing complex database systems to support the company's mission-critical applications. In this full-time position, you will work out of our office in North Jakarta, Jakarta Raya, playing a crucial role in the Information Technology & Communication department's Database Development & Administration team.

What you'll be doing ?

Database Architecture & Design : Design large-scale database architectures for both operational and analytical systems (OLTP & OLAP); Develop database schema blueprints, entity relationship models, indexing strategies, and partitioning approaches; Design data flows and replication topologies across systems (microservices, DWH, real-time pipelines); Define naming conventions, data modeling standards, and comprehensive documentation.

Performance & Scalability : Analyze and optimize query performance, indexing, and storage layers; Implement sharding, caching (Redis), and read replica strategies to achieve high scalability; Develop and monitor capacity planning and long-term data growth projections.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery : Design HA/DR systems using techniques such as streaming replication, failover clustering, and backup rotation; Define RTO/RPO targets in alignment with business SLAs; Conduct periodic disaster recovery tests to ensure system resilience.

Data Governance & Security : Implement data encryption, access control, and auditing policies; Ensure compliance with security standards such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS; Collaborate with the DevSecOps team to maintain data security and privacy.

Integration & Cloud Infrastructure : Design data integration across platforms (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.); Experienced in working with Cloud Platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure; Implement CDC pipelines and real-time synchronization across data systems.

Leadership & Collaboration : Provide technical direction to DBA, Data Engineer, and Developer teams; Collaborate with application and infrastructure architecture teams to design end-to-end systems; Develop database architecture documentation and best practice guidelines.


Requirement is :

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

Minimum 8+ years of experience in database design, development, and administration.

Proven experience in architecting large-scale and high-performance database systems (OLTP & OLAP).

Deep understanding of relational and non-relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.

Hands-on experience with data warehousing (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and ETL/ELT pipeline design.

Strong knowledge of database performance tuning, indexing, query optimization, and partitioning.

Company Description


About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description


Get to Know the Team

The GFin Analytics team serves as the intelligence engine driving data-informed decisions across our payments and financial services products. As part of the Payments Tech Family, we're instrumental in accelerating cashless payments across all Grab verticals.

We're looking for analytically rigorous data analysts who have embraced AI as a force multiplier. If you excel at experimentation and behavioral analysis while leveraging LLMs to work smarter, and if you think in terms of scalable solutions rather than one-off analyses, we want to talk to you.

Get to Know the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Analytics) to lead critical analytical projects for the GFin Analytics team at Grab. Our mission centers on understanding user experiences at a granular level and collaborating with Business, Product, Design, and Engineering to deliver the right outcomes and features. You will directly report to the manager. You will be based onsite.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Design, measure, and recommend A/B tests and multivariate experiments across the platform. These experiments evaluate layout optimization, UI/UX efficacy, contextualization, algorithm performance, and API effectiveness. Additionally, use LLMs to accelerate experiment design, automate statistical analysis, and create insight narratives.
Extract insights from clickstream and transactional data to understand user behavior across consumers, driver partners, and merchants, translating patterns into relevant product metrics, using AI coding assistants to write and improve complex SQL queries.
Create segmented customer and merchant views that allow business and product team to drive meaningful product iterations, building AI assisted segmentation frameworks that automatically identify emerging patterns and anomalies.
Transform ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical frameworks and conduct deep dive analyses that yield clear insights, using LLMs to rapidly prototype analytical approaches and synthesize findings into compelling narratives.
Balance analytical rigor with technical complexity and explainability while considering real world business constraints, leveraging AI to generate multiple solution approaches and evaluate trade offs efficiently.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define key metrics, align on measurement strategies, and design robust experimentation approaches, using AI to draft documentation, create presentations, and automate routine reporting.
Develop data-driven solutions, including reports, dashboards, models, and frameworks, that directly support stakeholder decision making. These solutions involve building AI-powered self-serve analytics tools that scale automatically and systematically.

Qualifications


What Essential Skills You Will Need

4 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science, in a Tech (FinTech or E-Commerce) company.
A minomum of Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields.
Experience in SQL (Presto, Hive) and visualization tools with solid Python or R programming skills, demonstrating daily use of AI and LLMs to create code faster than traditional methods.
Experience using AI tools to increase personal productivity with prompt engineering skills for code generation, analysis, and documentation, and AI coding assistants already integrated into your workflow.
Experience with apply AI solutions versus traditional approaches, can identify high ROI automation opportunities, and stays current with LLM and GenAI advancements through rapid experimentation.

Life at Grab

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

What We Stand For At Grab

title: Data Modeler

The Data Modeler plays a critical role in designing, developing, and implementing robust data models that support data-driven decision-making and enterprise analytics. This position collaborates closely with data architects, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable conceptual, logical, and physical data models. The role ensures data accuracy, integrity, consistency, and governance while maintaining comprehensive documentation and metadata. Success in this position requires strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, and the ability to communicate complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to support large-scale data initiatives and analytics projects.

• Familiarity with industry frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK is a plus.

• Proven ability to design and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

• Hands-on experience in designing and implementing database structures.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

We are seeking a highly technical Business Intelligence Engineer to design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure that powers our analytics. Capable of coding with data processing tools are a major plus (e.g., Jupyter, Python).

Deep understanding of data modeling and data warehouse design principles (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas) to build efficient data backends.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to debug complex data pipelines, optimize query performance, and troubleshoot data integrity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with BI Analysts and business stakeholders to translate their requirements into technical specifications.

Experience with modern data stack tools is a plus (e.g., dbt, Airflow, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or other data orchestration tools).

title: Business Operations & Management Associate
job_description:
🚀 About the Role

We’re looking for a Business Operations & Management Associate who can sit in the middle of numbers, processes, and people.




This role is a mix of:

Operations execution (data, reports, accuracy), and

Management support (coordination, follow-up, making sure things actually get done).

You’ll act as a bridge between management and day-to-day operations — making sure plans don’t hanya berhenti di slide, tapi beneran kejadian di lapangan.

Most people will find this role too structured, too demanding, or too detailed.

We’re looking for the outliers who enjoy ownership, clarity, and measurable results.




🧩 What You’ll Be Doing

You will be the operational backbone that helps management run the business with clean data and disciplined execution.


Operational & Data Responsibilities:

Manage financial and performance calculations for internal programs (bonus, rewards, rebates, and other schemes).

Monitor and ensure data accuracy across systems (CRM, trading platforms, trackers, and internal reports).

Conduct regular checks and mini-audits to identify and resolve discrepancies.

Maintain structured trackers, logs, and documentation that management can rely on anytime.




Management & Coordination Responsibilities:

Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Business Development, Product, Finance, Back Office, Operations) to align data, processes, and timelines.

Help management track commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups across ongoing initiatives.

Prepare concise reports and summaries for management, turning raw data into clear insights and next steps.

Identify recurring operational issues and propose practical improvements (better SOPs, checklists, workflows, or templates).

What Success Looks Like (First 3 Months)


By month 3, we’ll consider you successful if:

All recurring reports and calculations under your scope are on time, accurate, and complete.

Operational discrepancies are spotted early, investigated, and closed within an agreed SLA.

Management can see and track ongoing operations more clearly because of your structure (trackers, follow-ups, summaries).

You’ve driven at least 1–2 small but real improvements in how we work (e.g., new process, better template, clearer flow).




Requirements (Must-Haves)

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field (minimum GPA 3.2).

1–3 years experience in business operations, finance, project coordination, or management support roles.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, conditional formulas, basic modeling).

High attention to detail — you don’t tolerate messy numbers or unclear processes.

Proven ability to take ownership: you don’t just wait for instructions, you move things forward.

Comfortable in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with shifting priorities.

Willing to work on a shift-based schedule, including certain holidays when operations require it.

Based in Indonesia and willing to relocate if needed.

Proficient in English, both written and verbal, for business and professional communication.




Nice-to-Haves

Experience in brokerage, fintech, trading, or financial services.

Experience handling commissions, rebates, incentives, or performance-based rewards.

Experience coordinating between multiple departments and consolidating information for management.

Familiarity with CRM platforms, reporting tools, or basic BI tools is a plus.




This role is for you if:

You enjoy being the person who makes sure things actually get done, not just someone watching from the sidelines.

You like mixing numbers + structure + coordination in your daily work.

You want a role where you get exposure to management decisions, while still being hands-on in operations.

You get satisfaction from turning chaos into something that’s tracked, measurable, and under control.

job_description:
Requirement for Middle Level:

1. Min experiences 3-5 years as Data Engineer (Junior,Middle, Senior Level)
2. Experience in writing SQL query, SQL function and SQL procedure is mandatory
3. Experience in develop Microsoft Power BI Dashboard is mandatory
4. Have experience in SSRS reporting,  Google Big Query, ETL & data pipeline is advantage.
5. Have knowledge and experience in data science with Phyton is advantage.

Requirement for Junior Level :

1. Programming and Scripting: Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for pipeline development.
2. Database Management: Expertise in SQL and Gogle Big Query
3. Data Modeling: Ability to design schema and data models optimized for analytics.
4. Big Data Tools: Knowledge of platforms like Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, or Flink for processing large datasets.
Problem Solving: Analytical skills for troubleshooting pipeline issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring data integrity.

Core Responsibilities
1. Data Pipeline Development and Management
Data engineers create and manage the pipelines that extract data from various sources, transform it into usable formats, and load it into databases or data warehouses (ETL/ELT processes). They ensure that data flows reliably from source systems to reporting and analytics platforms.
2. Data Storage and Architecture
They design and maintain scalable and secure data storage solutions, such as relational databases, NoSQL databases, and cloud-based data warehouses. They establish schemas, indexing strategies, and storage models optimized for performance and analytics.
3. Data Quality and Governance
Data engineers enforce data quality standards, implement validation and cleansing processes, and monitor pipelines to detect and resolve inconsistencies. They also ensure compliance with data governance policies and standards, including privacy regulations.
4. Performance Optimization and Scalability
Optimizing database queries, improving pipeline performance, and planning for scalable infrastructure to manage growing datasets are key responsibilities. This includes tuning systems to handle large-scale batch and real-time processing efficiently.
5. Collaboration with Stakeholders
Data engineers work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand their data requirements and provide reliable datasets for analysis, reporting, and machine learning applications.
6. Tooling and Automation
They leverage tools such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Airflow, and cloud services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to automate workflows and manage large-scale data processing.

title: Staff Data Engineer (Managerial Level)
job_description:
About us:  

Populix is a consumer insights platform that helps businesses connect with its database of respondents and provides them with insights to better understand the preferences of Indonesian consumers. Populix has a pool of over 1,000,000 diverse, readily accessible, and highly qualified respondents across Indonesia. Its products range from intensive research studies to simple surveys and can be arranged on a project or subscription basis. Focusing on Indonesian consumers being super sticky to their phones, Populix facilitates a diverse range of data collection methods via its mobile app.

About the Role:


Populix is building the future of AI-powered market research, combining structured data, unstructured insights, and generative AI into a seamless research intelligence platform. As a Senior/Staff Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines and infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure high-quality, timely data powers business decisions across the organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will write production-grade code, architect data solutions, mentor team members, and drive best practices in data engineering, governance, and security.
 

Key Responsibilities :

Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python/Spark/Rust for data processing.
Build and optimize data transformations and aggregations for analytical workloads, including complex SQL with CTEs, window functions, and analyzing query execution/query planner.
Develop and manage workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow/Dagster/Prefect (or other orchestration tools).
Architect and maintain cloud-based data infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging services such as BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Google Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Compute Engine, and Cloud Functions for Data and Machine Learning workload.
Design data models and schemas that support OLAP analytics, reporting, and downstream machine learning use cases.
Implement data quality checks, validation frameworks, monitoring, and alerting for pipeline health and data integrity.
Ensure data systems comply with security standards, including ISO 27001, SOC Type 2, data privacy regulations like UU PDP, and internal information transfer policies.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data pipelines, data models, infrastructure, and operational procedures.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

Required Qualifications :
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform, or Software Engineering (data-focused roles).
Experience with analytics engineering tools such as dbt or Dataform is a plus.
Familiarity with FastAPI or other Python web frameworks for data service APIs is a plus.
Strong understanding of data governance, data security, and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001) is a plus.

Pendidikan minimal S1 (Statistika, Matematika, Ekonomi, atau Manajemen lebih disukai).

Direct Impact: Ide dan analisismu akan langsung diterapkan di 20 cabang kami.

title: Tencent Cloud- Big Data Migration Architect (Indonesia)
job_description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses. What the Role Entails


1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:

Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.

2. End-to-End Project Management & Delivery: Take ownership of the overall project schedule, risk control, and technical solution governance. Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.

3. Process Assurance & Technical Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex issues during migration. Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.

4. Deep Technical Optimization: Provide full-stack technical support, including but not limited to SQL syntax automated conversion/rewriting, Spark/Flink operator tuning, and post-migration performance benchmarking. Ensure that business performance on Tencent Cloud meets or exceeds expectations.

5. Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

Who We Look For


1. Hardcore Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields; 5+ years of experience in Big Data. Proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, or Python) with strong coding skills and logic conversion capabilities.

2. Overseas Stack Expertise: Familiar with the architecture and use cases of at least one major product: BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake. Understand the differences between these and open-source ecosystems (Spark, Hive); cross-cloud migration experience is a plus.

3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.

4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).

5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.

6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent


As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
